# Work in Progress

> A public sociology blog by the American Sociological Association examining economy, work, labor movements, and inequality through rigorous research and accessible analysis.

Work in Progress is an ASA-affiliated sociology blog that publishes peer-reviewed research findings on labor, economic inequality, and social mobility. The site combines in-depth research articles with weekly news roundups connecting current events to sociological insights.

## Key Topics

- Economic Sociology
- Labor and Labor Movements
- Inequality and Poverty
- Social Mobility
- Gig Economy
- Occupational Characteristics
- Precarious Work
- Sexual Harassment
- Tax Policy
- Motherhood Wage Penalty
- Occupational Licensing
- Social Origins
- Bureaucratic Power
- Worker Rights

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org): Homepage for Work in Progress sociology blog on economy, work, inequality
- [About Us](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/about-us): About Work in Progress: ASA public sociology blog on economy, work, inequality
- [Editorial Team](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/editorial-team): Editorial team members of Work in Progress blog led by Matt Vidal

## Research Articles

- [How do occupational characteristics hinder or empower mothers?](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2018/01/10/how-do-occupational-characteristics-hinder-or-empower-mothers): Research on motherhood wage penalty and occupational characteristics
- [Occupational licensing has no effect on wages, but does increase access to occupations](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/28/occupational-licensing-has-no-effect-on-wages-but-does-increase-access-to-occupations): Research on occupational licensing effects on wages and labor access
- [Studying precarious work](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/20/studying-precarious-work): Research on precarious work, gig economy, and labor insecurity
- [Sexual harassment, bureaucracy and discretionary power in the US military](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/13/sexual-harassment-bureaucracy-and-discretionary-power-in-the-us-military): Research on sexual harassment and bureaucratic power in US military
- [The path from social origins to top jobs: is it all about education?](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/05/the-path-from-social-origins-to-top-jobs-is-it-all-about-education): Research on social mobility, education, and occupational attainment

## News Roundups

- [Friday Roundup – December 22, 2017](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/22/friday-roundup-december-22-2017): Weekly news roundup on homelessness, poverty, and social policy
- [Friday Round – December 15, 2017](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/15/friday-round-december-15-2017): Weekly news roundup on sexual harassment, net neutrality, and politics
- [Friday Roundup – December 8, 2017](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/08/friday-roundup-december-8-2017): Weekly roundup on maternal mortality, racial disparities, tax policy
- [Friday Roundup – December 1, 2017](https://workinprogress.oowsection.org/2017/12/01/friday-roundup-december-1-2017): Weekly roundup on tax policy, gig economy, gun violence, politics
